description: Calculate hypergeometric probability of drawing specific cards from a deck. Returns: {odds_one_in}. See list_bundles for related 'jeux-probabilites' calculators.

cards_in_deck_matching.description: Number of target cards in the deck

deck_size.description: Total number of cards in the deck (default 52)

target_cards.description: Number of target cards wanted in the draw

name: calculate_card_draw_probability

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Card Draw Probability
